AlanGlucose — a brain for evaluating and building a business, one phase at a time, built for a single UK founder.

**To start:** download `AlanGlucose.zip` below, extract it (Windows: right-click → *Extract All…*; Mac: double-click), rename the `AlanGlucose` folder to your venture's name, open it in the Claude Code app as a new session, and say hello. The full steps are in `README.md` inside the folder.

**You need:** the Claude Code app with a Claude subscription. Nothing else. Python, Node, git and API keys are optional — the brain asks, and works without them.

**Other harnesses:** the folder also carries `AGENTS.md`, `.agents/skills/` and a `.codex/` adapter for Codex and similar tools. Not yet tested end-to-end there.

**Something broke?** Open an issue with what you typed and what you saw: https://github.com/Barticom94/AlanGlucose/issues
